title: GDC Weather
description: GDC weather station — live conditions (Prometheus) and history (InfluxDB).

list.name: period
list.label: Window
list.description: Aggregation window for min / mean / max / percentiles.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Outdoor air temperature. Sparkline: last 24 h.

panels.title: Feels like
panels.description: Heat index. Orange ≥ 32 °C extreme caution, red ≥ 41 °C danger, dark red ≥ 54 °C extreme danger (NWS).

panels.title: Humidity
panels.description: Relative humidity.

panels.title: Wind
panels.description: Latest wind speed.

panels.title: Gust · 10 min
panels.description: Highest gust in the last 10 minutes. Yellow ≥ 39 km/h strong breeze, orange ≥ 62 gale, red ≥ 89 storm.

panels.title: Direction
panels.description: Direction the wind is coming from.

panels.title: Max Gust
panels.description: Highest 10-minute gust in the selected time range.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "wind_speed_hi_last_10_min")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1.609344}))
  |> max()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "weather")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "temp")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (r._value - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0}))
  |> min()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

from(bucket: "weather")

panels.title: Prevailing Wind
panels.description: Speed-weighted circular mean of wind direction (vector average, so 350° and 10° average to N, not S).

panels.title: Wind Rose
panels.description: Share of readings by direction (16 sectors) and speed band. Raw readings, not averaged — averaging would invent calm directions in gusty wind.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and (r._field == "wind_dir_last" or r._field == "wind_speed_last"))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.wind_dir_last and exists r.wind_speed_last)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, dir: float(v: r.wind_dir_last), speed: r.wind_speed_last * 1.609344}))

panels.title: Wind & Gust Speed
panels.description: Per window (see Window variable): wind min–max ribbon with mean line; gust mean (dashed) and max.

targets.query:
s_wind_min = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "wind_speed_last")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1.609344}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Wind min")

s_wind_mean = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "wind_speed_last")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1.609344}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Wind mean")

s_wind_max = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "wind_speed_last")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1.609344}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Wind max")

s_gust_mean = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "wind_speed_hi_last_10_min")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1.609344}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Gust mean")

s_gust_max = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "wind_speed_hi_last_10_min")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1.609344}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Gust max")

union(tables: [s_wind_min, s_wind_mean, s_wind_max, s_gust_mean, s_gust_max])
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Wind Speed Distribution
panels.description: Each column is a time slice, each cell a 5 km/h band; brighter = more readings. Shows where the bulk of the wind sits, not just the peaks.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "wind_speed_last")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1.609344}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Wind"})

panels.title: Wind Direction · percentiles
panels.description: Median direction (solid) with 25–75 % (inner) and 10–90 % (outer) ribbons per window. Narrow = steady wind, wide = shifting. The axis wraps at SE, the rarest direction here, so the common W ↔ N swings stay continuous.

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "wind_dir_last")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: (int(v: r._value) + 225) % 360) * 400.0 / 360.0}))

pct = (q, name) => data
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: q, column: column), createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: name)

union(tables: [pct(q: 0.10, name: "p10"), pct(q: 0.25, name: "p25"), pct(q: 0.50, name: "p50"), pct(q: 0.75, name: "p75"), pct(q: 0.90, name: "p90")])
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: Mean sea-level pressure per window.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "242" and r._field == "bar_sea_level")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 33.8639}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${period}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Sea-level pressure"})

panels.title: Rain · daily
panels.description: Total rainfall per day.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "rainfall_last_24_hr")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 25.4}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0.0)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Rain"})

panels.title: Daily Temperature Range · last 400 days
panels.description: Each column is one day, each cell 1 °C; brighter = more hours at that temperature. Fixed to 400 days regardless of the time picker.

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Is Prometheus able to scrape the poller's /metrics endpoint?

panels.title: Last Reading
panels.description: Age of the newest sensor reading in InfluxDB. The poller runs every 5 min; amber > 15 min, red > 30 min.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "temp")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

panels.title: Samples · 24 h
panels.description: Temperature readings stored in the last 24 hours.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r.sensor_type == "37" and r._field == "temp")
  |> count()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Uptime · range
panels.description: Share of scrapes where station data was fresher than 15 min.
